'''Fallix water''' was a beverage that existed during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], New Republic [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] drank cool fallix [[Water/Legends|water]] while at the [[Surtsey]] residence of [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], a former Chief of State.<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>
